cards.title: Read and write
sections: Ben tries on a boot, but its lace is too short. At home, he likes a soft slipper instead of an outdoor shoe. Mia wants sandals for summer. One sandal has a high heel, so she chooses a pair with low heels. They both check that the shoes are comfortable.
Why does Mia choose a different pair of sandals?
Write two sentences using two words from today’s new word bank.

cards.title: Your A1 checkpoint
sections: Try the five tasks before opening the models. A partner may speak slowly or repeat. Listen to the dictation and write what you hear.
Order a drink and a simple meal politely.
Ask for a price, then say these prices aloud: $14, $40 and $60.
Ask for a number of apples and an amount of rice.
Ask for a size or color and say how you want to pay.

Write a shopping list, then check the details with a partner.
Review words: shoe, sock, white, size, price. Cover the list; recall meanings and use two in your own sentences.
cards.name: Everyday English - A1 - Day 090 - Review & Check - 01
cards.answer:
Dictation: Yes. I need socks, too.
1: For example: A tea and a sandwich, please.
2: How much is that? Fourteen dollars; forty dollars; sixty dollars.
3: For example: Two apples, please. Some rice, please.
4: For example: Large, please. The blue one. Can I pay by card?
5: Use real or invented quantities. Check that your spoken order matches the list.
For each task, note: I can do it; I can do it with repetition; I need more practice. Repeat difficult tasks another day with new details. Clear meaning matters more than a perfect accent.
